description.zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为**zh**。取值：

- **zh**：中文
- **en**：英文
description.en:
The language type for requests and responses. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English.
The IP address of the access source.

description.zh:
指定服务器的防护状态。取值：
- **on**：开启防护
- **off**：关闭防护    

> 关闭当前服务器的网页防篡改防护后，会释放出一个防篡改授权数。
description.en:
The protection status of the server. Valid values:
- **on**: Enables protection.
- **off**: Shuts down protection.    

> After you shut down web tamper-proofing for the server, a tamper-proofing authorization quota is released.

description.zh:
要修改防暴力破解状态的服务器UUID。
您可以调用[DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~)接口获取服务器的UUID。
description.en:
The UUID of the server for which you want to modify the brute-force attacks prevention status.
You can invoke the [DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~) operation to obtain the UUID of the server.

title.zh: 修改网页防篡改防护状态

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas modify-web-lock-status --source-ip 125.71.XX.XX --lang zh --uuid inet-12345670000 --status on --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas ModifyWebLockStatus --region cn-hangzhou --Status on --SourceIp '125.71.XX.XX' --Uuid 'inet-12345670000' --Lang zh
